description:
Naruto Uzumaki, a hyperactive and knuckle-headed ninja, lives in Konohagakure, the Hidden Leaf village. Moments prior to his birth, a huge demon known as the Kyuubi, the Nine-tailed Fox, attacked Konohagakure and wreaked havoc. In order to put an end to the Kyuubi's rampage, the leader of the village, the 4th Hokage, sacrificed his life and sealed the monstrous beast inside the newborn Naruto.

Shunned because of the presence of the Kyuubi inside him, Naruto struggles to find his place in the village. He strives to become the Hokage of Konohagakure, and he meets many friends and foes along the way.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

To commemorate the ONE PIECE anime's 25th anniversary: THE ONE PIECE anime by WIT Studio will recreate the story of the original ONE PIECE manga, starting from the East Blue arc.

(Source: Netflix, edited)

description: An anime short that screens alongside the Jujutsu Kaisen: Kaigyoku・Gyokusetsu compilation film, before it begins. Gojo, Geto, and Shoko have a little chat before their film starts in the theater.

"I'm heading out on a mission for the ages, ya hear me?!"

Team 7 members Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura are given a mission by Kakashi. Since Kakashi cannot participate himself, Naruto is appointed acting leader. As a result of this decision, Naruto is fully motivated to make the mission a success. However, on the way, Team 7 finds themselves lost in another world.

What appears before the bewildered trio is a boy with a face resembling a frog's, named Fūsuke. What awaits them in this strange new world?

(Source: NARUTO x NINKŪ Official Site)

Note: The official website for the NARUTO anime franchise announced a new anime project: to air four "brand-new" episodes to celebrate the TV anime's 20th anniversary back in 2022.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

This year is the 10th anniversary of Naruto's serialization start. This work will feature an episode with Team Kakashi from Naruto's youth era. It will be surprisingly different from the TV series, don't miss it‼
